file=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.env(\..*)?$'; then echo 'BLOCK: Refusing to edit .env files - contains secrets'; exit 2; fi
